in_marathi.name: Namitraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namitraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Namitraj is a name derived from Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism and is believed to be a powerful invocation of the divine.

vedic_reference.note: Namitraj is a form of Lord Shiva, derived from the word Namah, which means 'obeisance' and Itraja, which means 'to the one who is worshipped by all'. It is mentioned in the famous Shiva mantra 'Namah Shivaya'.
